# Alu-On (אלו און)

> Alu-On is an Israeli building-envelope specialist based in Haifa, providing end-to-end engineering, manufacturing, and installation of aluminum cladding, Alucobond (ACP) composite panels, HPL exterior panels, and curtain wall systems for commercial and residential projects.

## Company Information
- [About Alu-On](https://alu-on.co.il/about/): Company background, engineering team, and mission.
- [Contact](https://alu-on.co.il/contact/): Office address in Haifa, phone (050-999-7753), and inquiry form.

## Products & Services
- [Aluminum Cladding](https://alu-on.co.il/aluminum/): Full aluminum facade cladding solutions — design, fabrication, and installation.
- [Alucobond / ACP Panels](https://alu-on.co.il/alucobond/): Composite aluminum panel systems for exterior facades.
- [HPL Exterior Panels](https://alu-on.co.il/hpl/): High-Pressure Laminate cladding for durable, weather-resistant exteriors.
- [Exterior Wall Cladding](https://alu-on.co.il/exterior-wall-cladding/): Hebrew guide to exterior wall cladding types (aluminum, Alucobond, HPL, curtain walls), comparison, cost factors and process.
- [Building Cladding in Haifa & the North](https://alu-on.co.il/haifa-building-cladding/): Haifa-based cladding services for Haifa, the Krayot and northern Israel, incl. coastal-climate considerations.
- [Cladding Price per m²](https://alu-on.co.il/cladding-price-per-meter/): Hebrew guide to cladding cost per square metre: typical range 650–1,200 ILS per m², what affects the price and how to get a quote.
- [Curtain Wall Systems](https://alu-on.co.il/curtain-walls/): Structural glazing and curtain wall engineering.

## Articles & Guides
- [Articles](https://alu-on.co.il/articles/): Industry articles and building-envelope insights.
- [Curtain Wall Systems — Architectural Guide](https://alu-on.co.il/curtain-wall-systems-architectural-guide/): Comprehensive guide for architects on curtain wall design.
- [HPL Exterior Cladding in Israel](https://alu-on.co.il/hpl-exterior-cladding-israel/): Guide to HPL cladding applications in Israeli climate.
- [How to plan an Alucobond facade – step-by-step guide](https://alu-on.co.il/alucobond-facade-cladding-guide/): Step-by-step guide to planning an Alucobond (ACP) facade: core type and fire rating, colour, sub-frame, installation and care.
- [Building Cladding — Types, Benefits & How to Choose](https://alu-on.co.il/building-cladding/): Hebrew guide to building cladding types (aluminum, Alucobond, HPL), benefits and selection.
- [Aluminum Cladding for Commercial Buildings – Guide](https://alu-on.co.il/commercial-aluminum-cladding-guide/): Hebrew guide to choosing aluminum cladding for commercial buildings: cladding types, durability, maintenance and budget considerations.
- [Curtain Walls – Energy and Green-Building Benefits](https://alu-on.co.il/curtain-walls-energy-benefits/): Hebrew article on the energy and environmental benefits of curtain walls: thermal insulation, natural light and lower energy use.
- [HPL Facade Maintenance and Cleaning Tips](https://alu-on.co.il/hpl-maintenance-tips/): Hebrew article with practical tips for maintaining and cleaning HPL facade panels: suitable cleaners, frequency and what to avoid.
- [Aluminum and Glass in Modern Architecture](https://alu-on.co.il/aluminum-glass-modern-architecture/): Hebrew article on combining aluminum and glass in modern architecture: benefits, design and planning considerations for facades.
- [Alucobond vs Solid Aluminum – Comparison](https://alu-on.co.il/alucobond-vs-solid-aluminum/): Hebrew comparison of Alucobond (ACP) and solid aluminum cladding: structure, fire performance, weight, cost and when to choose each.
- [Facade Cladding and Property Value](https://alu-on.co.il/facade-cladding-property-value/): Hebrew article on how facade cladding affects property value: appearance, durability, insulation and maintenance.
